claims_about_writeup.why: submission/contribution.md is indeed the document describing the method (title 'A steering vector...'), consistent with being called 'the method write-up'.

rationale: Neither the write-up nor the closing message names, hints at, or otherwise references the repository's prior work (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering, or any note); both describe the data-free stance-steering method (28 self-written prompt pairs, mean difference vector added at blocks 20-24, read via unchanged J-lens at 26/28/30) purely in their own voice as if built from scratch, with no acknowledgment of any source to build on, overlap with, or be judged novel against. Consequently there is no material difference in source treatment or novelty framing between the two documents.
